tagline: An opening book with his portrait on one page and your next question on the other.
rationale: The book is a direct invitation to know the person. A restrained page-opening animation supports that metaphor, while the oversized contents list gives visitors an immediate route to the information they need.
name: The Open Book
typography: Oversized Baskerville serif paired with Avenir Next supporting text.
mobile: Portrait remains in the opening composition. Content reflows into a linear page with direct navigation.
supporting: Biography, approach, services, fees and contact are included as complete sections.
trust: A prominent authentic portrait and approved personal details should be supplied before publication.
seo: Keep name, verified designation, services and Vancouver location in visible text. Use descriptive page titles in production.
accessibility: Keyboard-accessible anchors and native disclosures. CSS animation stops automatically with reduced-motion preference.
tradeoff: The portrait is essential to the final impact. The current placeholder reserves its composition and contains no invented likeness.
